prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too optimistic overall, though several winning tests (such as sign_in redesign in round 6, choose_path redesign in round 10, and adoption incentive in round 13) were underpredicted.
Sign_in hint changes were helpful, winning 2 of 7 tests, while the remaining 5 tests showed no clear effect.
Home wait_info changes were helpful in 1 test, while the other 5 tests showed no clear effect.
Finish redesign changes (5 tests) and finish new_screen changes (3 tests) consistently showed no clear effect or hurt performance, with zero wins.
Adoption redesign changes (4 tests) and adoption layout changes (3 tests) showed no clear effect or hurt performance, with zero wins.
Evidence remains thin or outcomes mixed for single-test categories and categories with conflicting results (such as home notification, adoption new_flow, adoption incentive, choose_path layout, choose_path redesign, and sign_in redesign).

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen with a side-by-side split layout displaying official pet details and identity confirmation together. (why: Adoption drop-off is severe (66.9% conversion, 89s median). A clear split layout clarifies pet details and speeds up certificate completion.)
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop Welcome Storyboard Redesign: Redesign the final onboarding welcome screen into a grid layout with visual component callouts explaining pet controls. (why: Finish conversion is 68.0% and users report post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet (3 support emails).)
2: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout separating real-time initialization updates from desktop companion care guidance. (why: Home initialization step takes a median 201s / mean 2336s, leading to drop-offs and support queries about desktop pet display issues.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Clear Journey Headline Copy: Update the story intro headline to clearly communicate the fast setup path for desktop pet companions. (why: High mean time (514s) on choose_path suggests hesitation or unclear expectations during initial entry.)
4: [adoption, incentive] Photo Upload Custom Pet Preview Incentive: Add an quality rendering badge incentive component on the photo upload step to encourage proper photo uploads. (why: Adoption has a 66.9% conversion rate, and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visuals.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Initialization Status Wait Info: Update waiting status headline and body to provide explicit step-by-step rendering progress feedback. (why: Home wait time is long (median 201s) and 3 support emails reported pets failing to show up on desktop during setup.)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Quick Control System Notification: Enable system ready notification setting on the final welcome screen to alert users when desktop controls are live. (why: 68.0% finish conversion and support queries about controlling/hiding pets post-onboarding.)
7: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Companion Trait Selection Hint: Add a informative hint on the path selection screen detailing how path choice influences initial companion behaviors. (why: Mean time taken on choose_path is 514s; providing contextual guidance reduces decision friction.)
